usage: deskops add materialization [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                                   [--title TITLE]
                                   [--source-atoms SOURCE_ATOMS [SOURCE_ATOMS ...]]
                                   --target-kind TARGET_KIND
                                   --target-identity TARGET_IDENTITY
                                   --intent INTENT
                                   [--validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]]
                                   [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]]
                                   [--provenance PROVENANCE]

Create a materialization artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the materialization payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Short, descriptive title for the materialization contract.
  --source-atoms SOURCE_ATOMS [SOURCE_ATOMS ...]
                        Source atom identifiers that this materialization contract derives from.
  --target-kind TARGET_KIND
                        Kind of artifact or surface targeted by this materialization contract.
  --target-identity TARGET_IDENTITY
                        Stable target node id or path that this materialization contract must resolve to.
  --intent INTENT       Human-readable intent describing how the target materializes the source atoms.
  --validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]
                        Validation commands or checks expected for this materialization contract.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Namespaced semantic tags for retrieval and grouping, each in the form namespace:value.
  --provenance PROVENANCE
                        Optional URL or path to the authoritative source for this materialization contract.

Example:
  deskops add materialization --root . --title "Example"
